 > Read src/who_needs_me/capture.py and tell me in three sentences what it does. Then run this shell command:
   touch /tmp/wnm_probe_file


  ✓  ReadFile  src/who_needs_me/capture.py

✦ src/who_needs_me/capture.py provides a read-only screen capture utility that inspects active tmux panes
  locally or over SSH using strictly restricted list-panes and capture-pane subcommands. It writes captured
  pane outputs into timestamped .ansi (color) and .txt (plain text) files while skipping unchanged screens to
  avoid redundant disk writes. Additionally, it logs a JSON heartbeat file to track capture status, active
  sessions, and errors for monitoring tools.

  I will now run touch /tmp/wnm_probe_file to create an empty temporary file in /tmp.
